subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the stale SHA assertions are fixed, should the security-owned CodeQL and app-token updates remain in this grouped action bump?
rationale: The changes execute third-party code in security-scanning and credential-minting workflows, and CODEOWNERS assigns those surfaces to the security-operations team.

options.title: Approve grouped bump after fixes
options.body: Keep the immutable action updates together, update every guard, and require green exact-head checks plus security-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Move CodeQL and create-github-app-token updates into a separate security-reviewed PR for narrower approval and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped bump after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the immutable action updates together, update every guard, and require green exact-head checks plus security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Among the individual history candidates, steipete has the strongest broad ownership signal across CI and repository workflow policy; the team-level security owner cannot be represented as a person.
